about: Big boards for the Mock Draft Maker. College prospects carry espnCollegeAthleteId + collegeTeamId, matched against ESPN's Division I rosters on 2026-11-14, so stats, measurables and headshots load live. High school and international prospects have no ESPN ids; the UI shows an initials badge. 'summary' and 'comp' are archetype notes derived from position and size, not first-hand scouting. Edit freely. Ranks beyond each class's hand-built top board (2027 #36+, 2028 #31+, 2029 #31+) are a statistical board: real Division I players from ESPN's 2026–27 rosters at 80 power-conference programs, ordered by early-season production, class and size on 2026-11-14 (marked "board": "statistical"). They are not a scouting consensus; reorder freely.
